configurations.name: astro-dev
configurations.//: Astro 7 needs Node >=22.12. Load nvm and honour .nvmrc first, so the server does not start on whatever node the login shell happens to expose. Falls through to plain `npm run dev` where nvm is not installed.
runtimeArgs: [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use >/dev/null 2>&1; exec npm run dev
